mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, enabled, system, version FROM iam_role WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT g.permission_code, g.scope, u.unit_id FROM iam_role_grant g LEFT JOIN iam_role_grant_unit u ON u.role_id = g.role_id AND u.permission_code = g.permission_code WHERE g.role_id = #{role} ORDER BY g.permission_code, u.unit_id
SELECT count(*) FROM iam_role WHERE lower(code) = lower(#{code})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_role (id, code, name, enabled, system, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{enabled}, #{system}, #{version})
INSERT INTO iam_role_grant (role_id, permission_code, scope) VALUES (#{role}, #{item.permissionCode}, #{item.scope})
INSERT INTO iam_role_grant_unit (role_id, permission_code, unit_id) VALUES (#{role}, #{item.permissionCode}, #{item.unitId})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM iam_account_role WHERE role_id = #{role}
